bio_md:
# 汉殇帝 · 主要事迹

刘隆是[[e-han-he|和帝]]少子。元兴元年十二月，和帝崩，皇后邓绥迎立尚在襁褓的刘隆为帝——即位时出生不过百余日，是中国帝制史上即位年龄最小的皇帝。

殇帝在位不足一年，朝政自始便在邓绥的临朝称制之下：邓后以女主之身摄政，尚能以宽简为治，史载延平年间政令颇有可观者，然皆其祖母所为，与这个百天之帝无关。延平元年八月，殇帝崩，在位不满周岁，葬康陵。

殇帝之立与殇帝之崩，是东汉幼主政治的第一个极端样本：皇帝已经幼小到无法成为任何意义上的政治主体，皇权只是太后与外戚手中的一个名号。邓后旋定策迎立清河王子[[e-han-an|刘祜]]，是为安帝——东汉的每一次权力交接，从此都要经过宫闱之内的定策。

> 参考：点校本《后汉书》卷004《孝殇帝纪》、《皇后纪·和熹邓皇后》，谭图第 2 册。

bio_parts_en.value: Liu Long was the youngest son of

. In the twelfth month of the first Yuanxing year, Emperor He died, and Empress Deng Sui brought in the infant Liu Long as emperor — barely a hundred days old at his accession, the youngest emperor ever enthroned in Chinese imperial history.

He reigned less than a year, and government was from the start in the hands of Deng Sui's regency: the empress dowager ruled as a woman in her own right, and the histories credit the Yanping years with a measure of lenient order — all her doing, nothing to do with the hundred-day emperor. In the eighth month of Yanping 1 he died, having reigned under a year, and was buried at Kangling.

His enthronement and his death are the first extreme specimen of Eastern Han's child-emperor politics: the sovereign had become too young to be any kind of political subject, and imperial power was merely a title in the hands of an empress dowager and her kin. — from then on, every succession in Eastern Han passed through a decision made behind the palace gates.
